speech_review.scope: Concise sign identification only; supplemental plates, applicability, distances and unrecognized numeric values are not inferred. Runtime display, country rollout and speed gates remain unchanged.

caveats: The catalog mixes legacy sign codes and 2024 artwork renditions. Definitions follow each entry’s pinned source_provenance, not a wholesale change to the future road code.

D1c points right at the junction, D1d passes left, D1e passes right, D1f points left and D1g points right. Their existing classifier aliases conflict; labels identify the sign code but speech remains absent.
D3a (ahead or left), D3b (ahead or right), and A7b (narrowing from the left) were visually checked against the regulation/Wallonie images.
The pinned 2024 C23 artwork denotes buses; the no_hgv alias is unresolved and silent. Legacy C22 remains the coach prohibition.
Current baseline corrected maxheight to C29 (height) and blocks its unrecognized numeric pictogram; it remains silent.
The pinned 2024 D10 is the end of the separated path and D11 a shared path; their existing start/pedestrian-only aliases remain silent.
A1c and A1d reverse the first-bend directions implied by the existing aliases. Only the shared double-bend meaning is spoken; no side is inferred.
E9b permits motorcycles, cars, dual-purpose cars and minibuses, not only cars. The concise label names the permitted categories.
C8 is identified as an agricultural-vehicle prohibition from the pinned 2024 source; this metadata does not authorize rollout of that sign or pack.
Added exact current A1a (left bend) and A1b (right bend) display mappings. No model, artwork or eligibility is added here.
